title: Marguerite (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, Marguerite. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2725); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0.
